ValidationRule.description: A Lead whose contact is still the Needs to Identify placeholder stays at Identify: blocks creating it at, moving it to, or renaming it to a placeholder at Qualify, Engage or Qualified. No exemptions, like the conversion guard.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Contact_Name_Unknown_CC__c, OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status), ISCHANGED(LastName) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualify"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Engage"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Identify the contact first: replace the "Needs to Identify" placeholder with the contact's real name before moving this Lead beyond Identify.
